pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with semi-sharp edge gradients; larger spatial area on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, fragmented shapes on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways with relatively uniform thickness and frequent trivalent junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of the mane visible along the dorsal neck ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark, stellate hyper-pigmented lesion on the posterior flank, disrupting the local geometric pattern of the pelage.
